metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2025 · Adolescence
metas.description: When a 13-year-old is accused of the murder of a classmate, his family, therapist and the detective in charge are all left asking what really happened.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2023 · The Night Agent
metas.description: Low-level FBI agent Peter Sutherland works in the basement of the White House manning a phone that never rings - until the night it does, propelling him into a conspiracy that leads all the way to the Oval Office.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2022 · Slow Horses
metas.description: A dysfunctional team of MI5 agents navigate the espionage world's smoke and mirrors to defend the UK from sinister forces.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2022 · The Terminal List
metas.description: A former Navy SEAL officer investigates why his entire platoon was ambushed during a high-stakes covert mission.
Multinational immigrants traveling from the old continent to the new encounter a nightmarish riddle aboard a second ship adrift on the open sea.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2025 · Alien: Earth
metas.description: When a mysterious space vessel crash-lands on Earth, a young woman and a ragtag group of tactical soldiers make a fateful discovery that puts them face-to-face with the planet's greatest threat.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2023 · Lioness
metas.description: CIA operative Joe McNamara and her team attempt to balance their personal and professional lives as the tip of the spear in the agency's war on terror.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2023 · The Diplomat
metas.description: In the midst of an international crisis, Kate Wyler, a career diplomat, lands in a high-profile job for which she is not suited, with tectonic implications for her marriage and her political future.
